_about: Public-domain Leander Sylvester Keyser (1856-1937), Lutheran professor of theology at Hamma Divinity School and naturalist, for the Word Hoard: The Rational Test, A System of Christian Ethics, Election and Conversion, A System of Natural Theism, A System of General Ethics, Contending for the Faith, A System of Christian Evidence, Man's First Disobedience, The Doctrines of Modernism, The Problem of Origins, A Manual of Christian Ethics, and his bird books (Bird-dom, In Bird Land, News from the Birds, Birds of the Rockies, Our Bird Comrades). He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 115 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
